notes.title: 🌟 Demo 3.0 Update Notes 🌟
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
It’s been 2 months since our last update, and we’re excited to share that Demo 3.0 is now live! 🎉
This will be the final demo update before the full release — thank you so much for your support and feedback so far!


🔧 Changes & Updates
🐞 Bug Fixes – many issues reported by players have been resolved

🃏 New Deck – discover new ways to play and strategies to try

⚔️ New Difficulty System

Clear Easy Mode to unlock new treasures

Challenge yourself in Hard Mode for tougher gameplay

🎨 UI & Art Polish – smoother visuals and interface improvements


💡 What’s Next
This is our last demo before the full release. We’ll keep polishing, balancing, and adding content to make sure the final version delivers the best experience possible.

Thank you again for playing our game and sharing your feedback — it really means a lot to our tiny team! 💖

👉 If you haven’t already, give Demo 3.0 a try on Steam!
